resources.string: You do not have permission to access this attachment, or it is no longer available.
The animated image was converted to a single still frame.
Camera permission was not granted. Enable it in system settings or choose an existing image.
No camera app is available. Choose an existing image or document.
Drag a corner to resize the crop, or drag inside it to move the selection. You can also use the sliders. Rotation takes effect when you apply the crop.
No downloaded files yet. Tap an attachment in a conversation to download it, then view it offline here.
The file is empty. Choose a file with content.
The file was saved to your chosen location.
Image orientation was corrected and it was converted to JPEG. EXIF and location metadata were removed.
The attachment is ready to preview or send with your message.
The file size or checksum does not match. It cannot be opened safely. Download it again or select the original file.
The combined image size exceeds the limit for one message. Remove some images or reduce their size and try again.
The declared file type does not match its content. Choose the correct original file.
The local file is missing or was cleared. Download or select it again.
No network connection is available. Check your connection and retry the file transfer.
There is not enough device storage to process this file. Free some space and try again.
Completed downloads can be viewed offline. Sharing or saving elsewhere creates independent copies. Removing a local file does not delete the server attachment.
Complete PDF. Pages: %1$d. Previewing one page does not truncate the file.
Unable to read this PDF or page. The file may be damaged, password-protected, or unsupported. Check the original file.
No valid upload receipt was received. The upload cannot be confirmed yet. Try again.
Remove the downloaded file “%1$s” and its record from this device. The server attachment and copies already saved or shared elsewhere will not be deleted.
Retrying downloads the file from the beginning, not from the previous position.
No app is available to choose, save, or share the file, or the system did not allow the action.
Only the first 64 KiB of text is previewed. The complete original file is kept; save or share it to read the rest.
The file exceeds the size limit for this operation. Choose a smaller file or reduce the image size and try again.
There are too many attachments or images for one message. Remove some and try again.
Unable to complete the file operation. Check your connection, the file, and device storage, then try again.
Unable to read or write this file. Check access permission, file integrity, and device storage.
The file address failed a safety check and access was blocked. Select the attachment again from within the app.
The image or PDF format could not be recognized. Choose a valid JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, or PDF file.
This file is kept unchanged and has no in-app preview. Save it elsewhere or share it with a trusted app to open it. Its content will not be executed here.
